name: Digital Lending — Prohibited Pool/Pass-Through Account Pattern
sourceDocument: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
supersedes: Guidelines on Digital Lending (September 2, 2022, RBI/2022-23/098 DOR.CRE.REC.66/03.10.001/2022-23)
issuer: Reserve Bank of India, Department of Regulation
clauseStatusDetail: The official RBI notification identifies clause 9(i)-(iii) as the loan disbursal, servicing and repayment requirements.
substanceCorroboration: nishithdesai.com analysis of RBI Digital Lending Directions 2025

ruleSubstance: Loan disbursements must be made directly into the bank account of the borrower. The RE must ensure that in no case shall the disbursal be made to a third-party account, including the accounts of any LSP or DLA. All loan servicing and repayment shall be executed by the borrower directly in the RE's bank account without the use of any pass-through or pool account of any third party, including LSPs.
observableGraphCondition: Any MoneyEdge with mechanism=POOL_PASS_THROUGH in the proposed graph.
implementationNotes: POOL_PASS_THROUGH mechanism value is set by the deterministic extractor only when evidence clearly indicates funds flowing through a third-party pool/treasury account before reaching the final destination.
The 2025 Directions supersede the 2022 Guidelines. The old citation (Para 10 of the 2022 Guidelines) was incorrect.

Note on 2022 old citation error: the previous implementation incorrectly cited Para 10 of the 2022 Guidelines. Even in the 2022 document, Para 10 covered data localisation / CERSAI requirements, not the disbursal flow rule.
